# ITCP Fundamentals

An internal traffic control plan governs the movement of workers, equipment
and vehicles inside the activity area.

## Worker visibility

High-visibility apparel should be Class 3 during night operations. Workers
must not enter the swing radius of operating equipment.

| Class | Conditions | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Daylight | Minimum acceptable |
| 3 | Night | Required without exception |

## The eight-step process

1. Identify the work zone limits and the internal work space.
2. Map equipment travel paths, using the zones established in Step 1.
3. Assign a spotter wherever Step 2 shows a crossing conflict.

## Operation templates

### Asphalt milling

Milling operations shall use a dedicated spotter positioned outside the swing
radius of the milling machine at all times while the machine is operating,
and the spotter shall maintain direct line of sight with the operator during
every reversing movement performed anywhere within the internal work space.
